headline: AI chip rout: Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day in 18 months, closing near the lows with VIX up about 70%.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite fell about 5.5% to 24,315, closing near the session low and entering correction as AI chip and data-center stocks sold off (Nvidia -9%, QQQ -6.5%). Lower Treasury yields (10-yr 4.84%, down 6 bp) and a softer dollar cushion only partly, and Asian chip names led by Korea and Japan are the key read for tonight's session. The main risk is a short-covering bounce versus a further leg lower into tomorrow's 8:30 am New York jobs report.
